landing.title: Lay out coordinates on any PDF in seconds
landing.description: Upload your document to add JSON-backed annotations, reuse templates and export your work-ready files.
landing.tryExample: Try it with a sample document
landing.previewAlt: Preview of the PDF Annotator workspace

precision.title: Exact coordinates
precision.text: Every click becomes a position in PDF points, with guides and snapping for precise alignment.

json.title: Live JSON
json.text: Edit the JSON or the viewer: both stay in sync instantly. Import, copy and download.

templates.title: Reusable templates
templates.text: Save your annotations and apply them to other documents in one click.

privacy.title: Private by design
privacy.text: Everything happens in your browser. Your PDF is never uploaded to any server.

customHint.pdf: Enter point values separated by commas or spaces. Y values are measured from the bottom edge of the PDF.

color.hintEdit: Paste an existing HEX or RGB value to reuse exact colors.

custom.hint: Toggle this option to load your own font files from the advanced menu.

batch.panelHint: Click a document to open it in the editor. What is missing comes first.

step1.title: 1 · Upload the PDFs
step1.text: All the documents you want to work on. You can add more or remove some.

step2.title: 2 · Upload the templates (JSON)
step2.text: Optional. One JSON per PDF with the same name (invoice.json for invoice.pdf). Without a template the PDF starts with no annotations.
step2.pastePlaceholder: Paste the templates here: an array, one document or several in a row (for example, what you extract from Mongo).
step2.pasteHint: They are matched by the pdfName field (or name, fileName, type). Mongo fields are ignored; only pages matters.
step2.pasteTooBig: The pasted text is over 5 MB.

versionsDrop.title: New versions (B)
versionsDrop.text: Got redesigned PDFs? Drop them here and they are paired by name with each PDF in the batch.
versionsDrop.addedText: The rest have no B version. You can drop more here.
versionsDrop.unpairedText: They do not match any PDF in the batch: assign them by hand or discard them.

resume.title: Saved batch
resume.text: You have a batch of {{count}} PDFs in progress.

doc.replaceConfirm: Replace this PDF with “{{name}}”? Annotations are kept.

a.title: ① Template of the original (A)
a.hint: The annotations of the original PDF. They are the base to edit this PDF or the reference for the new version.
a.replacesNote: Replaces the current annotations (can be undone).

error.tooBig: The JSON is larger than 5 MB.
error.noPages: No pages with fields were found in that JSON.

b.title: ② New version of the PDF (B)
b.hint: If there is a redesigned PDF, add it and you edit on it with A as a reference.
b.removeConfirm: Remove version B? Its annotations are lost and the original PDF is edited again with its template.

doc.noTemplateNote: No template: you can load the original’s or add a new version in Document.
